intro: Flower customs in Singapore can be quite practical. The safest choices respect the occasion, the family, the venue, and the mix of cultures involved.
imageAlt: Local flower markets arranged for a Singapore flower guide

sections.heading: Respect the setting
sections.body: Singapore flower customs vary by family, religion, workplace, and venue. When the occasion is sensitive, ask first or choose something simple and respectful.

sections.heading: Use colour thoughtfully
sections.body: Colours can carry different meanings across cultures. Red may feel festive, white may feel solemn, and bright mixed colours may work better for casual congratulations.

sections.heading: Let the card do the work
sections.body: A plain, sincere message prevents misunderstanding. This is especially helpful for sympathy flowers, business gifts, apologies, and formal occasions.
